newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Radex confirms to pay 15 pct 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Radex confirms to pay 15 pct 1996 dividend.

text.p: Austrian industrial group Radex Heraklith Industrie-Beteiligungs AG said on Wednesday shareholders had approved a 15 schillings dividend payment for 1996, up from 14 schillings the previous year.
In a statement, released after the annual shareholders' meeting, Radex reiterated it expected to better its 1996 results this year.
"That will take the firm a significant step nearer its target of a five percent return on sales in 1998," Radex said.
Last year Radex posted a group net profit of 582 million schillings, up from 467 million in 1995.
